chunks.section: Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Courses, Syllabi, Pricing, and Discount Catalog
chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Courses, Syllabi, Pricing, and Discount Catalog

## 1. Institutional Overview and CEFR Alignment
Global Language Academy is an accredited international language institute providing high-impact language training fully aligned with the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Our academic mission combines interactive communicative immersion (80% oral speech focus), native and C2 certified master educators (Cambridge CELTA/DELTA credentials), and modern digital tools to achieve rapid, measurable fluency for individual students, executives, young learners, and corporate teams.

---
## 2. Detailed Language Programs and Specializations

chunks.section: A. General English Program (Levels A1 to C1)
chunks.text:
### A. General English Program (Levels A1 to C1)
- **Target Audience**: Beginners to advanced learners seeking everyday fluency, travel confidence, professional communication, and academic reading/writing.
- **Competency Progression**:
  - **A1 (Beginner Breakthrough - A1.1 & A1.2)**: 120 total hours. Basic social interactions, personal introductions, ordering food, asking directions, present simple and basic past tense.
  - **A2 (Elementary Waystage - A2.1 & A2.2)**: 120 total hours. Daily routines, shopping, travel logistics, personal experiences, future plans, basic conversational spontaneity.
  - **B1 (Intermediate Threshold - B1.1 & B1.2)**: 120 total hours. Expressing opinions, professional emails, narrating past events, hypothetical discussions, travel problem solving.
  - **B2 (Upper-Intermediate Vantage - B2.1 & B2.2)**: 120 total hours. Complex professional arguments, abstract discussions, technical discussions, fluent spontaneous conversation without strain.
  - **C1 (Advanced Operational Proficiency - C1.1 & C1.2)**: 120 total hours. Academic debate, executive pitch presentations, negotiation nuance, idiomatic mastery, stylistic flexibility.
- **Total Duration to Reach Level B2**: From complete beginner (A1.1) to full B2.2 upper-intermediate conversational fluency takes **480 academic hours (8 sub-modules of 60 hours each)**, taking approximately **12 to 14 months in the Intensive track (15h/week)** or **20 to 24 months in the Standard track (6h/week)**.

chunks.section: B. Business and Executive English (Levels B1 to C2)
chunks.text:
### B. Business and Executive English (Levels B1 to C2)
- **Target Audience**: Managers, developers, corporate leaders, and remote professionals working with international clients in the US, UK, and Europe.
- **Focus Areas**: Cross-border contract negotiations, executive presentations, corporate finance terminology, sprint/agile meetings, technical documentation, professional diplomacy, and crisis communication.

chunks.section: C. International Exam Preparation Tracks (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge)
chunks.text:
### C. International Exam Preparation Tracks (IELTS, TOEFL, Cambridge)
- **IELTS Academic & General Training Prep**: 40-hour targeted workshop. Focus on Band 7.0+ strategies, Essay Task 1 & 2 rubric mastery, rapid reading scanning, and speaking interview simulation.
- **TOEFL iBT Prep**: 40-hour targeted workshop. Focus on 100+ composite score strategies, integrated speaking/writing tasks, and computerized audio lab training.
- **Cambridge FCE / CAE Prep**: 60-hour intensive preparation for official lifetime Cambridge certification.

chunks.section: D. French (Français - Levels A1 to C1)
chunks.text:
### D. French (Français - Levels A1 to C1)
- **Framework**: Official syllabus aligned with the CIEP and France Éducation International (DELF/DALF).
- **Core Modules**: Conversational phonetics, everyday life in Francophone countries, academic writing for French university admissions (Campus France), and professional communication in Canadian/European French.

chunks.section: E. German (Deutsch - Levels A1 to B2)
chunks.text:
### E. German (Deutsch - Levels A1 to B2)
- **Framework**: Aligned with the Goethe-Institut and TestDaF standards.
- **Core Modules**: German for academic migration, Studienkolleg preparation, job seeker visas, nurse/engineer professional homologation, and technical German.

chunks.section: F. Italian (Italiano - Levels A1 to B2)
chunks.text:
### F. Italian (Italiano - Levels A1 to B2)
- **Framework**: Italian cultural immersion, conversational fluency, and preparation for citizenship or academic requirements (CILS/CELI standards).

chunks.section: G. Portuguese (Português Brasileiro - Levels A1 to B2)
chunks.text:
### G. Portuguese (Português Brasileiro - Levels A1 to B2)
- **Framework**: Brazilian Portuguese for business opportunities in Mercosur and Latin America, tourism, and Celpe-Bras exam orientation.

chunks.section: H. Spanish for Foreigners (Español para Extranjeros - Levels A1 to C2)
chunks.text:
### H. Spanish for Foreigners (Español para Extranjeros - Levels A1 to C2)
- **Target Audience**: Expatriates, remote workers, digital nomads, and university exchange students living in or relocating to Colombia.
- **Curriculum**: Latin American cultural immersion, practical daily life, Colombian idioms, business etiquette, and DELE/SIELE exam alignment.

---

chunks.section: 3. Group Courses vs. Private 1-on-1 Mentorship (Operating Dynamics)
chunks.text: ## 3. Group Courses vs. Private 1-on-1 Mentorship (Operating Dynamics)

chunks.section: A. Group Courses Policy and Dynamics
chunks.text:
### A. Group Courses Policy and Dynamics
- **Do individual students need to form or bring their own group?**
  - **ABSOLUTELY NOT.** Individual students enroll individually. Global Language Academy organizes and manages the cohorts based on each student's exact CEFR level (determined by the free online placement test).
  - Cohorts maintain a strict cap of **maximum 8 students per classroom** (minimum 4) to ensure constant speaking time, personalized teacher feedback, and active peer collaboration.
- **Are tuition fees per person or per group?**
  - **All published tuition fees are INDIVIDUAL PER PERSON per module/level.**
  - Every individual enrollment includes official digital textbooks, unlimited 24/7 Virtual Campus access, weekly conversation clubs, and up to 2 free 1-on-1 makeup tutoring sessions.

### B. Group Tuition Fee Structure

| Program Track | Cadence & Schedule | Module Duration | Total Hours | Individual Tuition Fee (COP) | Approx. USD |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Standard Group (Quarterly)** | Mon–Thu (1.5h/day) or Tue/Thu (3h/day) | 10 Weeks | 60 Hours | **$1,250,000 COP** | ~$320 USD |
| **Intensive Group (Monthly)** | Mon–Fri (3h/day) morning or evening | 4 Weeks | 60 Hours | **$1,450,000 COP** | ~$370 USD |
| **Saturday Intensive Track** | Saturdays (8:00 AM – 1:00 PM) | 12 Weeks | 60 Hours | **$1,350,000 COP** | ~$345 USD |
| **Kids & Teens Track (Ages 8-15)** | Saturdays (8:30 AM – 12:30 PM) | 12 Weeks | 48 Hours | **$1,150,000 COP** | ~$295 USD |

*All tuition fees cover full module access, Cambridge/Oxford digital materials, audio labs, and level completion certificate.*

---

## 4. 1-on-1 Private Tutoring Packages (Custom Individual Mentorship)

Private sessions are 100% customized to the student's specific objectives, learning pace, and irregular schedule.

| Package Name | Included Hours | Total Price (COP) | Hourly Rate (COP) | Total Price (USD) | Package Validity |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Starter Pack** | 10 Hours | $850,000 COP | $85,000 COP/hr | ~$215 USD | 60 Days |
| **Fluency Booster** | 25 Hours | $1,950,000 COP | $78,000 COP/hr | ~$500 USD | 120 Days |
| **Mastery Package** | 50 Hours | $3,600,000 COP | $72,000 COP/hr | ~$920 USD | 180 Days |

- **Private Class Rescheduling Policy**: Students can cancel or reschedule individual sessions with at least **12 hours prior notice** via WhatsApp or the student portal at zero penalty cost.

---

chunks.section: 5. Discounts, Promotions, and Special Academic Bundles
chunks.text:
## 5. Discounts, Promotions, and Special Academic Bundles

Global Language Academy offers clear, cumulative discount policies:
1. **Early Bird Discount (15% OFF)**: Applicable when completing registration and payment at least 10 calendar days prior to the official course start date.
2. **Family & Sibling Discount (10% OFF)**: Applicable to two or more family members enrolling concurrently in any program.
3. **Full Annual Academic Bundle (25% OFF)**: Pay 4 consecutive levels upfront and receive a 25% discount on total tuition plus a free Cambridge/IELTS diagnostic prep kit.
4. **Corporate Agreement Discount (12% OFF)**: For employees of affiliated companies presenting active proof of employment.
5. **Student Referral Program**: Current students receive **$100,000 COP credit** for every referred friend or colleague who enrolls in a full module.

*Maximum cumulative discount cannot exceed 30% under any circumstance.*

---

## 6. Payment Methods and Financing Options

We offer secure, versatile payment channels:
- **PSE (Pagos Seguros en Línea)**: Direct bank debit from any Colombian financial institution (Bancolombia, Davivienda, BBVA, Banco de Bogotá, Nequi, Daviplata, Scotiabank Colpatria).
- **Credit and Debit Cards**: Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Diners Club (accepted online and at campus front desks).
- **0% Interest Financing**: Up to 3 monthly installments at 0% interest using any supported credit card or approved partner financing (Addi / Sistecredito).
- **Cash & Datafono at Campuses**: Accepted at front desk admissions offices in Bogotá (Chapinero and Chicó) and Medellín (El Poblado and Laureles).

chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Schedules, Modalities, and Attendance Policies

chunks.section: 2. Learning Modalities: In-Person vs. 100% Live Online
chunks.text:
## 2. Learning Modalities: In-Person vs. 100% Live Online

Students can select between two premier learning formats:

### A. On-Campus Immersive Experience
- High-tech acoustic classrooms with smartboards, ergonomic seating, and maximum 8 students per group.
- On-campus language café, high-speed Wi-Fi, and library lounges.
- **Campus Locations**:

  - **Bogotá Chicó / Parque 93**: Carrera 11 # 93a-30 (Executive business hub).
  - **Medellín El Poblado**: Carrera 43A # 5A-113 (Near Parque El Poblado & Oviedo).
  - **Medellín Laureles**: Circular 4 # 73-22 (Near UPB & Primer Parque de Laureles).

### B. 100% Live Online Platform (Virtual Immersion)
- Real-time live classes with certified native and bilingual teachers via enterprise Zoom & Canvas LMS.
- Interactive digital breakout rooms, live whiteboard collaboration, and recorded audio repositories.
- Same curriculum, speaking requirements, and certificates as in-person cohorts.

chunks.section: 3. Attendance, Missed Classes, and Makeup Policies
chunks.text:
## 3. Attendance, Missed Classes, and Makeup Policies

- **Minimum Attendance Requirement**: To pass a module and receive an official CEFR certificate, students must attend at least **80% of scheduled class hours** (minimum 48 of 60 hours).
- **Automated Class Recordings**: Every Live Online session is recorded in HD and published to the Canvas Virtual Campus student portal within **2 hours** after class conclusion.
- **Free 1-on-1 Makeup Tutoring Sessions**: Every enrolled student has the right to **2 complimentary 45-minute private makeup sessions per module** with a tutor to review missed topics or prepare for assessments.

---

## 4. Schedule Changes and Transfers

- **Requesting a Schedule Change**: Students can request a shift or group change by notifying admissions at least **5 business days** in advance.
- **Immediate Transfers**: If an urgent work or personal conflict occurs, immediate transfers can be accommodated subject to open seat availability in the target shift.
- **Modality Swapping (Hybrid Flexibility)**: Students in on-campus programs can attend classes online via Zoom if traveling or unable to commute, ensuring zero lost hours.

chunks.section: Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Enrollment, Certifications, and Academic Policies
chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Enrollment, Certifications, and Academic Policies

chunks.section: 1. Official CEFR Certifications and International Validity
chunks.text:
## 1. Official CEFR Certifications and International Validity

- **Accreditation**: Global Language Academy is certified under Colombian Secretarías de Educación guidelines (SIET registry) and fully compliant with the Common European Framework of Reference (CEFR).
- **Certificate Features**:
  - Direct digital verification via unique **QR Code** and permanent cryptographic record.
  - One-click **LinkedIn Digital Credential** integration.
  - Detailed transcript specifying oral fluency, reading comprehension, listening accuracy, and written grammar scores.
- **Homologation and University Validation**: Valid for graduation requirements in major Colombian, Mexican, and Latin American universities (UniAndes, Javeriana, UPB, EAFIT, UNAM, TEC).
- **Embassy & Visa Support Letters**: Official enrollment certificates and progress reports provided for student and work visas (Germany Opportunity Card, France Campus France, Canada Express Entry, Australia VET).

---

## 2. Free Diagnostic Placement Test

- **Format**: 45-minute comprehensive adaptive evaluation (grammar, vocabulary, listening comprehension, and a 10-minute conversational interview).
- **Score Mapping (0–100%) to CEFR Level**:
  - `< 30%` ➔ **A1.1 (Foundations / Beginner)**
  - `30% – 49%` ➔ **A2.1 (Elementary Fluency)**
  - `50% – 69%` ➔ **B1.1 (Intermediate Practical)**
  - `70% – 84%` ➔ **B2.1 (Professional Upper-Intermediate / IELTS Prep Ready)**
  - `85% – 94%` ➔ **C1.1 (Advanced Executive)**
  - `95% – 100%` ➔ **C2 (Mastery & Certification)**
- **Cost**: 100% Free with immediate digital report.

---

## 3. Course Freezing (Congelamiento) and Pause Policies

- **Eligibility**: Students experiencing travel, temporary illness, or work overload can freeze their course.
- **Maximum Duration**: Up to **60 continuous calendar days** per academic level.
- **Advance Notice**: Notice must be submitted at least **5 business days** prior to the desired freeze start date.
- **Cost**: **$0.00 (Completely Free)** for up to 1 freeze per enrolled level. Subsequent freezes incur a minor administrative reactivation fee of $50,000 COP.

---

## 4. Cancellation and Refund Policies

- **Full 100% Refund**: If cancellation is requested in writing at least **5 business days prior** to the official course start date.
- **Partial 70% Refund**: If requested during the **first week (first 5 calendar days)** of the module (30% retained for administration and digital license costs).
- **After First Week**: Non-refundable, but remaining hours can be transferred to family members or credited toward a future course term valid for 12 months.

chunks.section: Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Student FAQ and Academic Policies
chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Student FAQ and Academic Policies

## 1. Academic Methodology and 80% Oral Immersion

- **Conversational Immersion**: 80% of classroom time is dedicated to student speech, debates, roleplaying, and collaborative problem-solving. Grammatical concepts are taught inductively through practical communication rather than passive rote memorization.
- **Master Instructors**: All teachers are certified native or C2-level bilingual educators with recognized international credentials (Cambridge CELTA, DELTA, or MA in Applied Linguistics).
- **Classroom Cohort Limits**: Strict cap of maximum 8 students per classroom (minimum 4) to ensure individualized feedback and speaking turns.

---

## 2. Digital Platforms and Educational Ecosystem

- **Virtual Campus (Canvas LMS + Zoom Pro)**: 24/7 student access to course syllabus, homework assignments, teacher feedback, and interactive quizzes.
- **Included Digital Textbooks**: Full digital access to official Cambridge University Press and Oxford University Press interactive e-books and audio labs (no hidden book purchases required).
- **Weekly Conversation Clubs (Clubes de Conversación)**: Unlimited, free weekly sessions organized by topic (Business, Cinema, Tech, Debates, Travel) across all active languages.

---

## 3. Payment Troubleshooting and Financial FAQ

- **PSE & Bank Debit Inquiries**:
  - If money is debited from the bank account but the platform shows "Pending", bank clearing networks (ACH / Redeban) typically take **15 to 30 minutes** to return the official CUS confirmation code.
  - If after 45 minutes the status is unchanged, the student should provide their **Full Name, Email, and CUS Transaction Number** to admissions for immediate manual activation.
- **Credit Card Denials**:
  - Often caused by bank security filters for online purchases or exceeding daily transaction limits. Students can retry via PSE or request a direct Bancolombia / Nequi payment link.
- **Financing with Addi / Sistecredito**:
  - Available for students without credit cards. Requires only Colombian Cedula and active WhatsApp number. Approvals in under 3 minutes with 0% interest on select terms.

---

## 4. Exact Physical Campus Locations

- **Bogotá Chapinero Campus**: Calle 63 # 11-45 (Edificio Global, 3rd Floor). Phone: +57 (601) 745-8800.
- **Bogotá Chicó Campus**: Carrera 11 # 93a-30 (Piso 2, Parque 93). Phone: +57 (601) 745-8810.
- **Medellín El Poblado Campus**: Carrera 43A # 5A-113 (Near Oviedo Mall). Phone: +57 (604) 604-5500.
- **Medellín Laureles Campus**: Circular 4 # 73-22 (Near UPB). Phone: +57 (604) 604-5510.
- **Admissions Working Hours**: Monday to Friday 7:00 AM – 8:00 PM; Saturdays 8:00 AM – 2:00 PM.

chunks.section: Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Admissions, Qualification, and Corporate Guide
chunks.text: # Global Language Academy - Comprehensive Admissions, Qualification, and Corporate Guide

## 1. Step-by-Step Enrollment and Registration Process

1. **Step 1 - Diagnostic Assessment**: Complete the free 45-minute placement test online or at any campus front desk to establish your exact CEFR entry sub-level (A1.1 through C2).
2. **Step 2 - Schedule & Modality Selection**: Choose your preferred shift (Early Bird, Morning, Afternoon, Evening, or Saturday Intensive) and format (On-Campus or 100% Live Online).
3. **Step 3 - Tuition Payment & Discounts**: Pay via PSE, Credit Card (up to 3 installments 0% interest), or Addi financing. Apply Early Bird (15% OFF) or Annual Bundle (25% OFF) if eligible.
4. **Step 4 - Platform & Materials Onboarding**: Receive Canvas LMS login credentials, Zoom classroom link, and Cambridge/Oxford digital textbook licenses within 15 minutes.
5. **Step 5 - Welcome Orientation & Class Start**: Attend induction session and begin communicative immersion.

---

## 2. Minor Student Enrollment (Kids & Teens Track)

- **Age Requirements**: Students ages 8 to 15 are placed in the specialized Kids & Teens Saturday immersion cohorts (8:30 AM – 12:30 PM).
- **Parental Consent**: Legal guardian must provide student identity document (Tarjeta de Identidad / Registro Civil) and sign the academic terms agreement.
- **Parent-Teacher Conferences**: Scheduled at mid-term (Week 6) and final term (Week 12) with personalized progress rubrics.

---

## 3. Corporate Sponsorships and B2B Agreements

- **Corporate Invoicing (Facturación Electrónica DIAN)**: Tax-compliant electronic invoices generated within 24 hours for corporate entities sponsoring employee language education.
- **Corporate Discounts**: 12% to 20% discount tiers based on company headcount enrollment.
- **Customized Corporate Cohorts**: Dedicated private groups tailored to company industry vocabulary (Software Engineering, Fintech, Legal, Oil & Gas, Healthcare).

---

## 4. International Students and Visa Requirements

- **Official Visa Support Certificates**: For international students moving to Colombia or Colombian students applying for study/work visas abroad, Global Language Academy issues certified study certificates, weekly hourly intensity verification, and tuition receipts recognized by consulates and embassies.
